result.title: Method for modifying hydrogel lubricating coating (amended)

limitations: L2: A method for modifying a hydrogel lubricating coating on a surface of general equipment
L3: comprising the following steps: depositing an adhesive solution of a catechol group-containing polymer on a surface of a substrate
L4: to obtain a polyphenol coating-deposited substrate
L5: wherein the substrate is general equipment
L6: and compounding the polyphenol coating-deposited substrate with a hydrogel monomer solution
L7: and conducting in-situ polymerization to obtain a hydrogel lubricating coating-modified substrate
L8: wherein the hydrogel monomer solution comprises persulfates and transition metal ions
L10: The method according to claim 1

evidence_passages: The prior art (US12350407B2) discloses a method for modifying a hydrogel lubricating coating on a surface of general equipment.

The method involves depositing an adhesive solution of a catechol group-containing polymer on a surface of a substrate, followed by compounding the polyphenol coating-deposited substrate with a hydrogel monomer solution and conducting in-situ polymerization to obtain a hydrogel lubricating coating-modified substrate.

motivation.motivation_passage: The prior art method may not provide optimal hydrogel lubricating coating performance, motivating the need for modification.
motivation.proposed_modification: modifying the hydrogel lubricating coating to improve its performance
motivation.why_this_specific_modification: to improve the hydrogel lubricating coating's ability to reduce friction and wear
